clips.title: The story
paras: The Darkspear have fled the Echo Isles, leaving their home under Zalazane's control. The tribe first settled here after crossing the Great Sea with Thrall, but now seeks to reclaim the islands.

The Darkspear made the Echo Isles their home after fleeing across the Great Sea with Thrall. Their peace broke when Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's naval forces invaded Durotar during Kul Tiras' attack. The trolls drove back Proudmoore's fleet, but another threat rose within the tribe. Zalazane, one of their witch doctors, seized dark arts and enslaved the minds of his kin. Chieftain Vol'jin and the free Darkspears fled the islands once more, finding temporary refuge across the narrow strait at Sen'jin Village.

Aggressive predators, tainted wildlife, and Zalazane's thralls now overrun the tropical islands. The rogue witch doctor uses malevolent hexes, voodoo fetishes, and ju-ju heaps across the isles to bend beasts and captive trolls to his will. Vol'jin's scouts and warriors set out from their camp at Darkspear Strand on frequent sorties. They seek the remains of their fallen and a chance to strike down the mystic who stole their home.
